verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no general-purpose public API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The only programmatic interface is an MCP connector for asking an AI assistant about the cap table, and it is explicitly 'All read-only'. That is an adjacent, query-only feature that leaves every write workflow (issuances, conversions, splits, buy-backs, vesting, signing) available only in the UI, so it does not deliver API parity with the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
